CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Start_Time__c), "--", LPAD( TEXT(MOD(HOUR(Start_Time__c) - 1, 12) + 1), 2, "0" ) & ":" & LPAD(TEXT(MINUTE(Start_Time__c)), 2, "0") & IF(HOUR(Start_Time__c) >= 12, " PM", " AM") ) & " - " & IF( ISBLANK(End_Time__c), "--", LPAD( TEXT(MOD(HOUR(End_Time__c) - 1, 12) + 1), 2, "0" ) & ":" & LPAD(TEXT(MINUTE(End_Time__c)), 2, "0") & IF(HOUR(End_Time__c) >= 12, " PM", " AM") )
CustomField.label: Start - End Time
